exposure: complex set of measures aimed at the mode of delivery in women with previous history of cesarean delivery
outcome: Trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC) rate
Successful vaginal birth after cesarean (VBAC) rate
cohort: Women with a history of cesarean delivery giving birth to singleton term cephalic pregnancies with a low transverse uterine incision
finding: Implementing a series of quality improvement interventions significantly decreased cesarean delivery rates and increased both TOLAC and successful VBAC rates without significantly impacting perinatal mortality.
mod_finding: The study found that the frequency of cesarean deliveries decreased from 89.94% in the pre-intervention period to 64.47% in the post-intervention period, while the frequency of TOLAC increased from 13.18% to 42.12%, and successful VBAC increased from 76.27% to 84.35%.
